title: GS21 with the priced y factor on the COUPON (floating-rate debt), three exposure types
question: Does a priced second factor make a fair gap in GS21 when firm exposure runs through debt service, i.e. through its own leverage?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-09). The leverage channel is the one GS21-native source of exposure heterogeneity not yet used: the coupon a firm pays, and creditors receive, becomes b * exp(gs_bk y), gs_bk < 0, so debt service rises in bad states -- floating-rate debt, or spreads widening on roll-over, which a large share of corporate borrowing does. A firm's cash-flow exposure to y is then -gs_bk b / (profit - coupon): its own leverage relative to profit, a ratio of two firm variables, convex as the coupon approaches profit. Three types in gs_bk, no compensation: at y = 0 the types are identical.

CALIBRATION (low resolution, xnum 41, znum 50, bnum 10, NY 9, 150 firms, 2026-10-09 16:30; low-res solves hit the sweep cap). gs_bk 0 / -0.1 / -0.2: type premia 3.2 / 7.3 / 10.2 %/yr, SR_max 0.31 / 0.37 / 0.43 by y-tercile, mean log size 4.10 / 4.07 / 4.04 (hidden). At -0.4 the exposed type de-levers and its premium falls back to 8.8% with log size 4.37, so the top of the ladder is -0.2 and the bottom type gets -0.03 so that every type loads.

CHECKS. E[M R] = 1 to 1e-15 on the calibration economies; gs_bk = 0 reproduces the solver exactly (ky = 1).

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids read from the Quest solve logs by verify_gs_vy_klc.sh before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-10-09, before the run). Market share of SR_max 60-80%; room +0.01 to +0.04; the decisive read is room_s against room (the exposure is a product of leverage and inverse profitability, an interaction the ranks do not span linearly, but on the production-exposure panel pairwise products added only 8 points of R^2). A fair gap of +0.005 to +0.012 if room_s is close to room. FALSIFIED as 'the leverage channel ports the KP mechanism to GS21' if the fair gap is below +0.005 or positive in fewer than 7 of 10 seeds.

RE-SOLVE 2026-10-10 07:30: sol_gvyk25c at gs_bk -0.2 hit the sweep cap (cycle-averaged, qerr_rel above the enforced 2e-5); the third type is re-solved at -0.15. The ladder is (-0.03, -0.1, -0.15).
